resources.string: Invalid Client ID or Client Secret
The code expired. Start the connection again.
Trakt requires an app in your name: create one at trakt.tv/oauth/applications with the redirect URI urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob, then enter its Client ID and Client Secret here.
Open %1$s or scan the QR code, sign in, and enter the code. Wicaby is waiting for approval.
Movies and episodes played in Wicaby are scrobbled to Trakt (start, pause, and stop), and “Watched” updates your Trakt history.
A server’s Trakt plugin already scrobbles, so Wicaby doesn’t do it twice. Without administrator rights, Wicaby can’t check plugins: turn off a server that already has the Trakt plugin.
The Client Secret and tokens are encrypted by the Android Keystore on this device and are never logged.
